copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 给你的 NanoClaw 接入 Slack:它会从 channels 分支复制 Slack 适配器并注册、装好依赖,引导你创建 Slack 应用、填好凭据,再重启服务;完成后机器人能在 Slack 频道和私信里收发消息。
howto.when: 当你需要把 Slack 接成聊天渠道时使用,通常在 /setup 流程中,或之后想给已有部署补上 Slack 支持时。

say.text: 帮我把 Slack 接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 会从 channels 分支复制适配器并注册

say.text: 用 Socket Mode 接入 Slack,不用公网地址
Slack 机器人收不到我的回复,帮我排查
say.note: 会检查事件订阅与 Messages Tab 设置

howto.what_en: Adds Slack to NanoClaw: it copies the Slack adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs the pinned package, guides you through a Slack app and credentials, then restarts the service so the bot can send and receive messages.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to add Slack as a chat channel — typically during /setup, or later to add Slack to an existing deployment.

say_en.note: Copies the adapter and registers it

say_en.text: Connect Slack with Socket Mode, no public URL
say_en.note: SLACK_APP_TOKEN switches it to Socket Mode

say_en.text: My Slack bot gets no replies
say_en.note: Checks event subscriptions and Messages Tab
